messages.text: Hi Neil, good to have you back. What can I help you with today? If it's your Thor P2 order, I can check where it stands.
it is about that. I did receive a package from Helium yesterday but it wasn't a Thor P2

I'm sorry, Neil. After the wait you've had, that's the last thing you needed. The UPS parcel that reached you yesterday came out of our Tennessee warehouse, and our records say a Thor P2 was packed in it. So it looks like they picked the wrong unit.

What's the model name on the miner or the box you got? If you can, send a photo of the unit and the label on the box too. With those, I can get the team started on putting it right.
Handed to the team · Replacement shipment and return label need team approval. Same situation as Kevi

Thanks, Neil. So the warehouse sent you a DC08, which is a Scrypt miner, not your Thor P2. That's our warehouse's mistake, not yours, and on top of a two-month wait. I'm sorry.

I've passed it to the team so they can get your Thor P2 out and sort out sending the DC08 back. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email at your iCloud address.

Until then, please leave the DC08 unplugged and in its box. If you have a photo of the unit and the shipping label, send it here and I'll add it to your ticket.

Thanks, Neil. I got the five file names, but the photos didn't come through on my end, so I can't look at them myself. Everything you post in this chat goes on your ticket, so the team has the names and our records of the mix-up either way.

Someone will pick it up and email you at your iCloud address about getting your Thor P2 out and the DC08 back. Until then, please keep the DC08 unplugged and in its box.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Got it, Neil, this one came through. The serial (number hidden) confirms it's a DC08, and the photo is on your ticket so the team can match it against the warehouse.

You don't need to send anything else. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you at your iCloud address about getting your Thor P2 out and the DC08 back. Until then, please keep the DC08 unplugged and in its box.
